insecure_protocols.reason: Direct SMB port frequently targeted by WannaCry/EternalBlue exploits.

details.mitigation: Replace FTP with SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol) or FTPS.
Implement DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) or DNSSEC to prevent spoofing/poisoning.
Migrate to HTTPS with TLS 1.3 encryption and HSTS headers.

recommended_firewall_rules.windows_firewall_cmd: netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="Block Insecure Port 21 (FTP)" dir=in action=block protocol=TCP localport=21
recommended_firewall_rules.linux_ufw_cmd: sudo ufw deny in proto tcp to any port 21 comment "Block FTP"
recommended_firewall_rules.rationale: Block unnecessary port 21 (FTP) on 127.0.0.1 to prevent unauthorized exploitation.

recommended_firewall_rules.windows_firewall_cmd: netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="Block Insecure Port 135 (MSRPC)" dir=in action=block protocol=TCP localport=135
recommended_firewall_rules.linux_ufw_cmd: sudo ufw deny in proto tcp to any port 135 comment "Block MSRPC"
recommended_firewall_rules.rationale: Block unnecessary port 135 (MSRPC) on 127.0.0.1 to prevent unauthorized exploitation.

recommended_firewall_rules.windows_firewall_cmd: netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="Block Insecure Port 445 (SMB)" dir=in action=block protocol=TCP localport=445
recommended_firewall_rules.linux_ufw_cmd: sudo ufw deny in proto tcp to any port 445 comment "Block SMB"
recommended_firewall_rules.rationale: Block unnecessary port 445 (SMB) on 127.0.0.1 to prevent unauthorized exploitation.

security_improvements.finding: Detected plain-text FTP traffic across network.
security_improvements.action_item: Replace FTP with SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol) or FTPS.

security_improvements.finding: Detected plain-text DNS traffic across network.
security_improvements.action_item: Implement DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) or DNSSEC to prevent spoofing/poisoning.

security_improvements.finding: Detected plain-text HTTP traffic across network.
security_improvements.action_item: Migrate to HTTPS with TLS 1.3 encryption and HSTS headers.

security_improvements.finding: Management devices and IoT cameras share the same subnet as workstations.
security_improvements.action_item: Isolate IoT devices and IP cameras onto a dedicated VLAN with strict inter-VLAN firewall routing.

security_improvements.finding: Static MAC filtering is vulnerable to MAC address spoofing (Phase 3 testing).
security_improvements.action_item: Enforce 802.1X Port-Based Network Access Control (NAC) instead of relying solely on MAC filtering.
